content.rendered: On Thursday, Nov. 9th, SMS students will honor area veterans by hosting the annual Veterans Day Breakfast.  Students invite veterans who are family or friends, or adopt a veteran for the day, to share this special event with them.The SMS band will perform the National Anthem along with the military theme songs and other patriotic favorites. Students and veterans alike, look forward to this special event.
